judge.rationale: The implementation is a textbook realization of the Zero-Trust Audit Principle ZT-2. It computes the access decision first, unconditionally appends a complete log record (role, permission, allowed, plus a bonus timestamp), and only then returns — making it structurally impossible for any code path to bypass the audit write. The logic is flat (no nested branches, no early returns), explicit (deny-by-default via `matrix.get(role, set())`), and locally auditable in a single glance. The docstring is thorough without being verbose, type annotations are precise, and the extra `timestamp` field adds operational value without violating any stated constraint.
